name: Dane Godioby
source:
A resident of Usodar Town. He is the new landlord of MC and runs a pet café downstairs from her office. He's a gentle big brother next door, and makes world-class delicious coffee. He takes great care of MC and is always the first to come to her aid whenever she's in danger. It seems that he knows everything about MC, even to the point of being a little obsessive.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570850/Heart_Cage/]Steam[/url]]
